findings.quote: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step has no vessel and can be mistaken for an additional reaction-heating operation. The preheated object is the aluminum block; preserve that apparatus-preparation detail separately from the subsequent 12-hour reaction heating.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not represent analytical monitoring.
